mainEntity.name: How long does the procedure take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ear lobe repair is usually completed within 30–60 minutes.

mainEntity.name: When can I wear earrings again?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your doctor will advise when the earlobe has healed enough to re-pierce, usually after several weeks.
A fine line may remain as the repair heals, and it usually becomes less noticeable over time.
